rows.en: <pic(0)><cs(3)>Axis<ce()> is closing in on <pic(1)><cs(3)>the Gate of Zedan<ce()>. There's no way left to avoid a collision...
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: The UCE has apparently given up the Gate of Zedan and ordered all fleets to evacuate.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: We may have parted ways with the UCE, but pointless annihilation must be avoided.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: The enemy is Neo Zeon, led by Char.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: Has he truly changed...? I can't say.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: This will surely be a hard battle. I wish you all success, and a safe return.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: More than half of the UCE fleet has been wiped out. The losses are immense...
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: Duke Dermail is missing as well. He most likely did not make it.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: With no chain of command, the UCE is paralyzed. No surprise for a patchwork force...
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: Other enemy forces are sure to take advantage of this and start moving on Earth.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: I want to call you back to Earth right away. Your strength is still needed.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: Now that Char is gone, Poseidal is the one who holds the key.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: To end this war, I want you to defeat Poseidal, who pulls its strings from the shadows.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: We can't stand still if we want peace. Don't let your guard down, even for an instant.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)
